_doc: Train definitions for tools/t0/build.py (see tools/t0/README.md). Trains are cumulative: a group whose 'first' train is X applies to X and every later train. Bundle groups always apply in 'group_order'.

base.what: the build baseline since 2026-09-30: what production serves, reconstructed at source level (baseline/dist); legacy/dist stays the immutable downloaded deploy 6aa16d61

R0.what: R0-intro-delete (perf-cwv-04) and, as the extension part R0+mapbox-precompile.json, R0-mapbox-precompile (the Mapbox shader programs of the app's own layers are requested before the first frame that draws them: chapter 02 section 14.21, owner decision in ops/T0-DEVIATIONS.md row 22); the rename/loader/SW mechanism itself is code, not a group

A.what: crash and input: C5 calls, sound, pointer capture, monuments loop, keys, storage, attribution, D-HEATMAP removals, the error boundary; extension part A+chooser.json: the legacy layout chooser is a keyboard-operable dialog

B.what: clock and data: date +2, day loading on jump, merge fix, stateless i2, minimap

C.what: mobile shell (bundle patches + index.html rows; the counts are in release/<train>/anchors.json and tools/t0/README.md); must precede AX

AX.what: a11y bridge (bundle patches + page rows); must follow C (G-close-mobile expects 3 hits)

CP.what: truthful-copy subset (bundle rows + Help-chunk rows); must follow C

A2.what: desktop fixes after the verifier round (a pointer press leaves keyboard focus off the map canvas so the documented shortcuts keep working, attribution and wordmark above the dock, Esc dismisses the story/event/tour card and the cards leave the controls free, unit canvas repainted on map move/zoom/resize and on filter change while paused, z9 overlay resized, NPS tour panel); bundle patches only; the monument star overlay the verifier saw does not exist in the baseline-built trains (production removed it, docs/baseline-drift.md section 5), so there is nothing to reproject; applies after CP so it anchors on the finished text of A..CP

SHELL.what: index.html shell: Extra Features overlay (menu fit, scroll and keyboard; hidden behind modals; placement that avoids panels and cards; Phone view, the way back from the desktop layout) and the phone onboarding overlay (the dock stays reachable); page-phase patches on index.html only, applied after CP so they anchor on the final text

PERF.what: first-paint performance of index.html: both stylesheets stop blocking the first paint (media=print, switched on by the loader before the app is imported) with the AX first-paint rules inlined; page-phase patches on index.html only, applied after SHELL (anchors: the stylesheet links, the loader start(), the first <style> line)

CLOCK.what: the clock of the battle in words (date and time of day instead of 'tick n of 675'), one oracle for every surface; tools/t0/CLOCK-README.md

DATA.what: the verified-data layer: 2,473 asserted corrections to the served data files and the pages that quote them (sources in docs/data-audit/fixes.json); must follow CLOCK; tools/t0/DATA-README.md; the gate row data-untouched accepts exactly the data files a DATA patch targets

MON.what: the Monuments layer (markers, cards, Jump to this moment, the Walkthrough bridge); tools/t0/MON-README.md; groups that need it carry a +mon extension part

ANIM.what: the ANIM engine: units as flags on a canvas laid out by the engine, its legend, hover and cards; tools/t0/ANIM-README.md; extension part ANIM+mon.json needs MON

POLISH.what: the final polish pass: one name per feature, the layout contract (nothing lands on anything else), targets, welcome window, Ask the Historian scroll; after CLOCK, DATA, MON, ANIM; tools/t0/POLISH-README.md (page part PG-polish)

PERF2.what: phone and tap performance of the app (roster slices, SVG names, precompile of the extra programs); tools/t0/PERF2-README.md (page part PG-perf2)

PERF3.what: phone blocking time and tap responsiveness: the unit canvas without a forced layout, the entry module cut after Mapbox GL; tools/t0/PERF3-README.md (page parts PG-perf3, PG-zperf3)

BASE1863.what: the 1863 reconstruction as the base map of the main maps (inline style, tile pyramid under /tiles1863/<version>/, permanent label, change layer); last in the order: it anchors on the finished text of the others; tools/t0/BASE1863-README.md

PERF4.what: phone blocking time of the app route: the map library evaluated in three tasks, the product layers added in four, the first frames kept apart by a frame governor, the first layout without the font cost, the engine's start-up split, program precompile at style load, no performance telemetry to Mapbox; tools/t0/PERF4-README.md (page part PG-zperf4)

ACC.what: accuracy group of round 3: the 107th Pennsylvania strength from its commander's report, no casualty rate for the 6th US Cavalry (data files already targeted by DATA), and no casualty rate above 100 percent on /regiment and /report (page part PG-zacc); generated by tools/t0/acc/gen.mjs

PERF5.what: desktop check 4 and phone ground-remembers: the first frame of the Virtual Walkthrough and of the Monuments layer in tasks of their own with their shader programs linked before they are drawn (the Walkthrough map is built a frame after the overlay is painted, its layers are added out of their zoom range when the style has loaded and shown in two steps; the four Monuments layers are shown in two steps), the heat layer of /ground-remembers in a task of its own (page part PG-zperf5); tools/t0/PERF5-README.md

PERF6.what: check 4 of round 5, desktop: the Unit Roster list is virtualised (rows in view plus 500 px, spacers of measured heights, role=list with aria-posinset/aria-setsize; page elements with the roster open 5,598 -> 1,053); the page part PG-zperf6 queues the circle and symbol programs with fog and without terrain, so 3D Terrain off on a tilted map links nothing inside a frame; tools/t0/PERF6-README.md, generated by tools/t0/r1g/gen_roster.py and gen_terrain.py

R0.what: mechanism: hashed names, boot loader, no-reload SW, kill switch, version.json, intro deletion

R1a.what: R0 + group A + page groups (PG-*) + assets overlay

R1c.what: R1b + B + DL + CP + generated config (headers/redirects)

R1d.what: R1c + the Release 1 groups (CLOCK DATA MON ANIM POLISH PERF2 PERF3 BASE1863 and their page groups PG-perf2 PG-perf3 PG-polish PG-zcopy2 PG-zimg PG-zperf3) + IMG overlay (common-r1d) + the new tutorial PDF + the Culp's Hill moment at 480 (python tools/t0/r1d_prepare.py first)

R1e.what: R1d + the Release 1 round 3 groups (PERF4 with its page group PG-zperf4, ACC with its page group PG-zacc, and the ANIM of round 3 as ANIM@R1e.json; python tools/t0/r1e_sync.py first)

R1f.what: R1e + the Release 1 round 4 group PERF5 with its page group PG-zperf5, and the ANIM engine that solves the next frame in a task of its own as ANIM@R1f.json (with PERF4@R1f.json: the names its dataset-split patch anchors on), and the page group PG-zfix (/watch-together never closes a Live Sync connection that is still opening; tools/t0/r1f/gen_zfix.py) (python tools/t0/r1f_sync.py first); R1e itself is frozen

R1g.what: R1f + the Release 1 round 5 groups: PERF6 (the Unit Roster list is virtualised) with its page group PG-zperf6 (precompile of the fog-without-terrain circle/symbol programs), the page group PG-ztail (/ground-remembers: the dark style fog is off for the first frames) and the SEO group PG-zseo (JSON-LD, twitter:card, crawlable tool list); python tools/t0/r1g_sync.py first; R1f itself is frozen

known_overlaps.resolution: C applies first; the a11y row then expects 3 hits instead of 4 (chapter 02 section 7)
adjacent finds share the text V.jsx("div",{style:tr.overlay; A's replacement keeps it, so the AX anchor matches in either order (build_selftest 5 builds both orders)
AX anchors on group C's output; AX must follow C
AX anchors on group C's output; AX must follow C

known_overlaps.a: mob:HF-6g append Extra Features groups to sheet
known_overlaps.b: cp:mobile-tools-footer (Privacy, Terms, credit; after group C HF-6g)
known_overlaps.resolution: CP anchors on group C's output; CP must follow C

legal._doc: Only used when the opt-in page group PG-legal is built (python tools/t0/build.py --train R1c --with PG-legal). effective_date (ISO) is the day the interim privacy/terms text is published: the build prints it as 'Month D, YYYY' wherever the patches say {{LEGAL_DATE}} (no wall clock, so builds stay deterministic). Set it to the production deploy day before the build that is deployed.
